[[Tanzit's Defender]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Tanzit Razorstone]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Strength]])
:Reduces [[Blind]] duration on you by 20%
:Received [[physical damage]] -2 (while in a [[Stance]])

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Shield of the Dead]].

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as it effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "I Can See Clearly Now" and "Run For Your Life!".

==Notes==
* To buy it as [[PvP reward]] red item, you have to unlock the [[PvP_reward#Exotic_Weapon|Exotic Weapon]] tab via [[Tolkano]] and pay  '''30''' [[Tournament Reward Points]] or '''5''' [[Gold Zaishen Coin]] to create this specific skin.
